items.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: and then I think it was Eric and then Jimmy Forrest, I don’t remember.

ctx.x: Who were some of your favorite arrangers for the Basie group at the time?

Well my favorite arrangers for the Basie group at the time were the ones that were in the band. Although Basie never recorded a full album of their work, or he may have, I think he did. I think the one for Frank, Chairman of the Board, that was all of Frank Foster’s. But I thought that the best writers for the band were the members: Frank Foster, Ernie Wilkins and Thad Jones and later on Eric. But like I say, Eric came after me. When I left I think Budd Johnson took my place, and then I think it was Eric and then…
Do you think it’s because those guys knew exactly what went well in the band, because they were right in the middle of it so they could write more effectively?
